track.title: Homayoun: Neydavud, Forud
track.notes: Tagged title: Neydavoud, Foroud. A different performance from the Homayoun suites of 'Lord of Setar' and 'Setar' (no onset alignment).

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Bb3 and dwells most on Cs in Neydavud. Forud (0:36.6) introduces Gk, D, centred on F. The line peaks at Bb4 (455.3 Hz) at 0:02.8. It closes on the tonic (F4 → F4 → Bb4 → Bb4 → F3 → F3).
